name: Katsushika Ayumi
source: A saleswoman of choco bananas who opened her mobile shop near the place where Jun'ichi works. Having a cheerful and friendly character, she finds a common language with the protagonist pretty quickly. But still, waters run deep. Knowing that he is married to Kotori, she offers him something he couldn't ask his wife for.
